description: This file defines classes related to MLIR connections in a build or compilation process, including connection handling, object FIFO management, and MLIR code generation for object FIFO operations.

classes.name: MLIRConnect
classes.description: Represents a data connection in MLIR between kernels, supporting broadcast connections and managing attributes such as source, destinations, number of bytes, and tiles involved.

classes.name: ObjectFIFO
classes.description: Represents an object FIFO connection in MLIR, inheriting from MLIRConnect, including methods for MLIR declaration, acquire, and release operations.

methods.name: next_id(cls)
methods.description: Class method that increments and returns a unique identifier for connections.

methods.name: reset_id(cls)
methods.description: Class method that resets the unique identifier counter to zero.

methods.name: None __init__(self, name:str, src:Tuple[str,str], dsts:Set[Tuple[str,str]], nbytes:int, offset:int, apptiles:Dict, appkernels:Dict)
methods.description: Constructor for MLIRConnect, initializing connection attributes such as name, source, destinations, transfer size, offset, and tile information.

methods.name: to_mlir_declare(self)
methods.description: Returns MLIR code to declare this object FIFO.

methods.name: to_mlir_acquire(self, io, indent)
methods.description: Returns MLIR code for acquiring this object FIFO in MLIR, for specified I/O type.

methods.name: to_mlir_release(self, io, indent)
methods.description: Returns MLIR code for releasing this object FIFO in MLIR, for specified I/O type.
